attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as router between lan-a (node2, 10.50.10.0/24 via eth1) and lan-b (node3, 10.50.20.0/24 via eth2). Applied a VyOS forward-filter policy: default-action drop, accept established/related, and accept only TCP/5432 from eth1→eth2. Configured static IPs/routes on node2 and node3 via nmcli, and opened firewalld TCP/5432 on node3 so the router policy (not the host firewall) is the enforcement point being tested. Verified node2→node3 TCP/5432 succeeds while ICMP, TCP/22, TCP/8080, and node3→node2 traffic are all rejected. Completed the mandatory restart protocol on all three nodes (boot_id changed on each, config/firewall/routes verified to persist, and end-to-end policy re-verified after all reboots).
